fields.description: A library banner, with the same text as the corrected toast, while the source folder cannot be reached or a folder sync fails. Each Retry press makes one root check (capped at 30 s) and at most one sync; no background retry. The banner clears as soon as the root lists with content (sync, Retry, Rescan or a watcher add) and the watcher restarts without a toast. partial-read stays log-only.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-15 by Blurby.Roadmap. Owner decision (option C, both; "button tries only once. No infinite loop") relayed by Blurby.Brain, with Brain's technical rulings (2026-10-15: clear at the root listing, Rescan clears, 30 s listing timeout). After FOLDER-UNREACHABLE-GUARD-1 and LARGE-FOLDER-SYNC-2. Not a release gate. Shared core: three optional lines in src/types.ts. Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
